title: www.cyrilvoyant.com: research stories, open courses and interactive scientific tools
description:
Archived snapshot of the website www.cyrilvoyant.com by Cyril Voyant (Mines Paris – PSL, Centre O.I.E.): plain-language accounts of published studies in energy and medical physics, open university courses, and interactive tools that let readers rerun each experiment in a browser, in English and French.

Each page names its own authors and sources. Published articles, software and courses keep their own DOIs, listed as related identifiers; this record gives a stable reference for the pages that have none.
